assertions.name: deuteron_rotational_energy_derived_within_10pct
assertions.source: E_rot(D) = μ₀·ℏ_q·J_q²(3) reproduces B_D to −9% with zero free parameters (μ₀, ℏ_q, J_q² all derived)

description: Derive-or-refute: is binding the q-Hamiltonian rotational energy E_rot = μ₀·ℏ_q·J_q²(j=n/2) with all factors derived? μ₀ = m_e/(3(q−q⁻¹)/2) ≈ 1.63 MeV (DERIVED, per-crossing scale; the earlier 249 MeV used the wrong spin-½ quantum). Result: D −9% (deuteron reproduced from fully-derived quantities, 0 free params), but T/³He/⁴He undershoot 44–72% — the same per-rep A≥3 deficit. So the gate is NOT the scale (μ₀ is derived) but the per-rep A≥3 structure: highest-weight j=n/2 collapses the per-block phase like the scalar trace. No fit.

conclusion.gate: NOT the scale (μ₀ derived) — the per-rep A≥3 structure; j=n/2 highest-weight collapses the per-block phase
conclusion.prior_error_corrected: earlier draft used spin-½ (j=½) → bogus 249 MeV; correct j=n/2 gives derived 1.63 MeV
